generic_domain.justification: Reinforcement Learning (RL) is a fundamental paradigm in deep learning that involves agents interacting with environments to learn optimal policies through trial and error. It serves as the overarching framework under which both multi-agent RL and multi-task RL operate. While multi-agent RL focuses on scenarios involving multiple intelligent entities collaborating or competing, and multi-task RL deals with agents handling several tasks simultaneously, both are specialized extensions of the broader RL domain. Thus, choosing 'Reinforcement Learning' as the most generic domain encompasses all these specific areas within its scope.
